_comment: BizyAir.ai business error-code classification with friendly hints. See references/04-common-reference.md for the full table.

retryable_biz_codes.30040: Max parallelism reached, wait for a running task to finish
retryable_biz_codes.30015: No available node, model temporarily unavailable

client_errors.30046: Task output not found or expired
client_errors.40025: input_values is required and must not be empty

friendly_messages.Insufficient balance: This account is out of balance. Top up at https://www.bizyair.ai/user/topup or switch to a funded account.
friendly_messages.Queue full, retry shortly: The queue is full, wait a little and retry.
friendly_messages.Max parallelism reached, wait for a runn: Too many tasks running at once, let one finish before submitting.
friendly_messages.No available node, model temporarily una: No free node for this model right now; try later or pick another model.
friendly_messages.Too many requests, slow down: Requests are coming in too fast, pause a few seconds.
friendly_messages.Invalid parameter: A parameter is invalid, check and retry.
friendly_messages.Please login: No valid API key. Set credentials.api_key in config.json or BIZYAIR_API_KEY, or create a key at https://www.bizyair.ai -> Settings -> API Keys.
friendly_messages.input_values is required and must not be: input_values cannot be empty; pass at least one field (usually the prompt).
